codex: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game UI button asset for BrineSpace, named codex. A wide horizontal rectangular physical push button, straight-on orthographic front view, centered, fully visible with generous transparent padding. Aspect of button itself 3.5:1, landscape canvas. Dark petrol teal enamel (#10272b), near-black recessed edges, worn brushed gunmetal bevels (#35565b), subtle scratches and four tiny corner screws. Restrained tactile hand-painted retro industrial science-fiction game art, crisp detailed edges, matching an underwater station UI. Low-key cool lighting, readable silhouette, muted pale sage engraved markings; no bright neon, no excessive glow, no orange or gold frame. Left quarter contains a small recessed reference terminal pictogram with an open technical manual on its screen in muted pale gray-green. Remaining right area is a flat dark teal recessed label plate, completely BLANK for runtime text. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, background scene or additional objects. Transparent background with real alpha. Only one button, idle/unpressed state. Same standardized simple clipped corners and understated metallic chassis as other buttons in this family.
